basis: The App Store privacy label for this app and the app's App Store description. Draft prepared 10 November 2026; awaiting the developer's confirmation.
summary: Somavue collects no data. There is nothing to sign in to and no analytics, advertising or crash-reporting SDK of any kind. Everything works offline.
onDevice: Your study progress, reviews, Study Sets, syllabi and annotations
purchases: Premium is sold through the App Store as a subscription (with a free trial) or a one-time Lifetime purchase. Apple handles payment.
extra: The 3D anatomical models come from BodyParts3D (© The Database Center for Life Science, CC BY 4.0) and are bundled in the app.
